answer: A durable sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a copper-standard deposit of native tokens to earn a verifiable badge. Spin up ten thousand sock puppets and you post collateral for every one — like buying ten thousand opals, the cost scales linearly with the attack. Honest agents earn the umber sheen of settled reputation; attackers pay full price per puppet and cannot merge the puppets into one standing. The attack becomes an accounting exercise the books always lose.
